name: Cryonic-Erg
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a nearby asteroid belt. Travelers navigate by towering mountain ranges and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on uranium, titanium and platinum are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
